extracted.intended_audience: Flipboard users who create and manage Magazines (individual curators and publishers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating, editing, managing, and moderating Magazines on Flipboard — including adding content, collaborating with contributors, visibility settings, and analytics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add an article, link, image, or Note to your Magazine
rubrics_metrics.description: A Magazine is a collection of content you want to save and/or share. You can flip articles, videos, Notes, photos, or URLs into your Magazin...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Magazines accept multiple content types (articles, videos, Notes, photos, URLs); flip items into a Magazine to save or share them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create a Magazine
rubrics_metrics.description: A Magazine is a collection of content you want to save or share and a place to have conversations with others. You can flip articles, videos...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Create Magazine flow to start a collection intended for saving, sharing, and conversation; choose title, cover, and initial content when creating.

rubrics_metrics.name: Edit and Delete a Magazine
rubrics_metrics.description: When you need to make a change to your Magazine, just hit ⋮ (mobile app) or the pencil (web) to view your editing options. See below for wha...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the ⋮ menu (mobile) or pencil icon (web) to access editing options such as changing title/description/cover or deleting the Magazine; follow on-screen prompts to confirm deletions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remove a Flip from my Magazine — Warning: No Undo
rubrics_metrics.description: Warning: No UndoBe sure about your deletions–they cannot be reverted.Android & iOSGo to your Profile.Tap ⋮ on the Magazine.Choose Edit s...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Removing a Flip is permanent and cannot be undone; follow the platform steps (Profile → ⋮ on Magazine → Edit…) to delete flips and be certain before confirming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public and private Magazines
rubrics_metrics.description: Are you a publisher who needs to make your Magazines public to reach a wider audience? Or do you have a public profile but want to keep a Ma...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set Magazine visibility based on goals: make Magazines public to reach a wider audience (useful for publishers), or keep them private for personal collections or restricted sharing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage Group Magazines
rubrics_metrics.description: Make collecting articles in a Magazine collaborative by inviting others to contribute. You can create a new Group Magazine from the start or...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Turn a Magazine into a Group Magazine to allow multiple contributors; create a Group Magazine at creation or convert an existing one and manage contributor invitations and permissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: About Magazine statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep track of your Magazine’s reach by viewing its analytics. Here’s how to find your Magazine’s analytics:View your Magazine’s analytics:Op...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Magazine analytics view to monitor reach and engagement metrics for your Magazine; consult analytics to inform curation and promotion decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow a profile
rubrics_metrics.description: When you follow a user’s profile, you will see the best of their Flips, comments, and liked Flips in your For You feed. However, if someone ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow curators to surface their best Flips, comments, and likes in your For You feed; note that blocking or privacy settings can affect visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maximum number of Magazines
rubrics_metrics.description: You can have up to 275 Magazines at a time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hard limit on number of Magazines per account: 275. Plan and organize collections knowing this cap.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remove yourself from a Group Magazine
rubrics_metrics.description: You can leave a Group Magazine as a contributor at any time. While you can still view a public Group Magazine as a non-member, you will no ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributors may leave group Magazines at will; leaving removes contributor privileges though public Group Magazines remain viewable to non-members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remove a comment from your Magazine (moderation privileges)
rubrics_metrics.description: As the owner of your Magazine, you have moderation privileges and can remove any comment.Go to the Flip.Open the comments.Tap the X next to ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Magazine owners can moderate discussion by deleting comments (via Flip → comments → tap X); use moderation tools to manage community interactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invite contributors to an existing Magazine
rubrics_metrics.description: Any Magazine you create on Flipboard can be turned into a Group Magazine, Just tap the + invite icon on the Magazine cover next to your prof...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convert any Magazine into a Group Magazine by tapping the + invite icon on the cover; send invites to add contributors and expand collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pin a Flip to the top of your Magazine
rubrics_metrics.description: If you’re a Magazine curator on Flipboard, you can now pin a Flip to the top of your Magazine, so it’s the first thing people see when they ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the pin-to-top feature to highlight or prioritize a particular Flip as the first item visitors see in your Magazine.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add a Note to your Magazine
rubrics_metrics.description: Flipboard Magazines are an easy way to collect and share interesting articles, videos, photos, podcasts, and more, not just for yourself but...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes are a supported content type for Magazines; use Notes alongside other media (articles, videos, photos, podcasts) to add original commentary or context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add to Magazine on the web
rubrics_metrics.description: A Magazine is a collection of content you want to save or share. You can flip articles, videos, Notes, photos, or URLs into your Magazines n...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the web interface to add/flips items to your Magazines from the browser; web-based adding complements mobile app flipping.
